name: MEDIMCOM IA knowledge base - source manifest
scope: Host country (United Arab Emirates) primary sources for the jurist agent; global policy examples for the gap analysis; Cameroon texts as comparative material only.

verification_levels.official_text: Provision read on the official publisher's site (government portal, regulator, EU institution, UN body).
verification_levels.secondary_source: Content confirmed only through a law-firm or press summary; obtain the official text before relying on it in production.
verification_levels.to_confirm: Listed for completeness; content not yet read in full.

warning: English translations of UAE legislation are for information; the Arabic text prevails. Prototype knowledge base for a hackathon: not legal advice.

sources.title: Cameroun - Loi n° 90/36 du 10 août 1990 relative à l'exercice et à l'organisation de la profession de médecin
used_for: Cameroon jurisdiction: practice reserved to physicians registered with the Order; illegal practice; professional secrecy
sources.note: Article text read on Camerlex (legal database reproducing the law), not on the Journal officiel: obtain the official text before production use.

sources.title: Cameroun - Loi n° 2024/017 du 23 décembre 2024 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel
used_for: Cameroon jurisdiction: sensitive (health) data, consent, transfers abroad, supervisory authority, compliance deadline, penalties
sources.note: Article numbers (9, 53, 70, 73) come from secondary summaries (anove.ai, obs-cc.org) that agree; the official text (prc.cm, Journal officiel) must be read before citation in production.

sources.title: Cameroun - Loi n° 2010/002 du 13 avril 2010 portant protection et promotion des personnes handicapées
used_for: Cameroon jurisdiction: deaf persons as persons with sensory disability; health care coverage; access to information technologies
sources.note: Copy of the law hosted by UN DESA; text read there. Sign language is not mentioned in the law.

sources.title: Cameroun - Décret n° 83/166 du 12 avril 1983 portant code de déontologie médicale
used_for: Cameroon jurisdiction: consent, information of the patient, written prescription, medical secrecy (articles to read)
sources.note: Published by the Ordre national des médecins du Cameroun; the file could not be read from our environment: decree number and articles to be confirmed before citation.

sources.title: Cameroun - Loi n° 90/035 du 10 août 1990 relative à l'exercice et à l'organisation de la profession de pharmacien
used_for: Cameroon jurisdiction: pharmacy and medicines (marketing authorisation to be checked with the national regulator)
sources.note: Listed in the WHO health legislation database; content not read.

sources.title: Cameroun - Loi n° 2016/007 du 12 juillet 2016 portant Code pénal (secret professionnel)
used_for: Cameroon jurisdiction: criminal sanction of breaches of medical secrecy (Art. 310 according to doctrine)
sources.note: Article 310 cited by an academic thesis (memoireonline); official text and penalty not read.
